scout.description: Fast codebase recon, return compressed context
scout.rationale: Flash model for speed, low thinking because scouting needs retrieval not reasoning

planner.rationale: Good instruction-following and breadth, medium thinking balances depth and cost

reviewer.description: Code quality, security, and architecture analysis
reviewer.rationale: Deep reasoning required for catching subtle bugs and security issues

implementer.rationale: Workhorse model for most implementation tasks, medium thinking balances quality and cost

expert (1st).description: Deep domain reasoning — delegate hard problems or consult when stuck. Primary expert.
expert (1st).rationale: Strongest reasoner for deep domain problems and primary consultation when stuck

expert (2nd).description: Expert consultation fallback — same issue, different perspective. Second consultation.
expert (2nd).rationale: High-thinking GLM-5.1 provides a different architectural perspective on second consultation

expert (3rd).description: Expert consultation fallback — same issue, third architecture. Final consultation before user escalation.
expert (3rd).rationale: Yet another architecture for a fresh perspective; final consultation before user escalation
